node-1.label: Right eye incomplete closure, right nasolabial fold flattening, and right-sided hemiplegia for 24 hours

node-2.label: A 66-year-old man with a 3-year history of hypertension and no history of neurological disorders presented with a 24-hour history of symptoms; he was alert and oriented.

node-3.label: Physical examination showed effacement of the right frontal wrinkle, incomplete closure of the right eyelid, flattening of the right nasolabial fold, muscle strength grade 0/5 in right upper and lower extremities, hypoesthesia on the right side, and a positive right Babinski sign.
